raw.transcript:
If you don’t know your router’s password, first check the sticker on the router itself. Many have a default username and password printed on the bottom or back. If your internet provider gave you the router, you might also find the login in their app or on your account page.

If you still can’t get in, you can reset the router to factory settings by pressing and holding the reset button, usually with a paperclip, for about 10 to 15 seconds. That wipes custom settings, so you’ll need to set up the Wi-Fi name and password again, and any special configurations will be lost. After that, create a new strong password, write it down somewhere safe, and reconnect your devices.
